semanticOracle: Compare complete candidate values to the separately authored expected file, not an engine-generated expected result.
byteOracle: The verifier's independent stdlib JSON locator finds these explicit fixture paths in both inputs; compare the three untouched byte segments around the two complete target values. Do not consume engine-provided spans.
allowedTargetLexicalVariance: Equivalent JSON value encodings inside the authorized value spans are allowed; every byte outside them must match.
evidenceMeaning: linked means referenced ID exists, not that any real-world finding has been verified.
